title: feat(gallery): polished cover tiles + graceful broken-image fallback
body: Card covers in ObjectGallery had two rough edges: - **contain covers stretched edge-to-edge** → giant glyphs dwarfing card content. Now centred at a capped size (≤50% / max 96px) on the soft-tinted backdrop → polished 'app tiles'. - **broken/404 cover URL → broken ``** (alt text on a blank box). Now `onError` falls back to the letter-avatar placeholder, same as the no-image case. Extracted a small `GalleryCover` child to hold the per-card error state. Full `turbo run build` 42/42 green. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
